definitions.explanation: The administration of a vaccine to prevent disease, or the act of receiving such a vaccine.

examples.japanese: {予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I get a flu vaccination every year.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the children's vaccination schedule.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (prevention) and ⟦{接種|せっしゅ}→接種：22649_sesshu⟧ (inoculation). This is the formal term for vaccination, used in medical and official contexts.

USAGE:
The standard expression is {予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a vaccination). In casual speech, ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to get a shot) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to get vaccinated
- {予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: vaccination certificate
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}: routine/scheduled vaccination
- ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}: optional vaccination

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan distinguishes between ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧ (routine, government-covered) and ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧ (optional, self-pay) vaccinations. Routine vaccinations for children are administered at local clinics with a {母子手帳|ぼしてちょう} (maternal and child health handbook).
